judgments.rationale: The existing record already fully conveys the statutory duty in its summary. Empty optional action fields are valid when the default statement already expresses that meaning, and filling them alongside a cosmetic paraphrase of modal wording ('is required to' instead of 'must') does not fix any defect or add needed content.

The proposed summary asserts that the employee must be permitted to use compensatory time immediately and even if it unduly disrupts agency operations, directly contradicting the statutory conditions in F003 that specify 'within a reasonable period after making the request' and 'if the use of the compensatory time does not unduly disrupt the operations of the public agency.'

source_spans.quote:
(5) An employee of a public agency which is a State, political subdivision of a State, or an interstate governmental agency—

(A) who has accrued compensatory time off authorized to be provided under paragraph (1), and

(B) who has requested the use of such compensatory time,


shall be permitted by the employee’s employer to use such time within a reasonable period after making the request if the use of the compensatory time does not unduly disrupt the operations of the public agency.
